verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a broad programmatic surface: an OpenAPI spec, an MCP server covering the entire Cloudflare API (over 2,500 endpoints across Workers and every other product), and Wrangler commands for managing Workers, including rollback via Wrangler or the dashboard. However, no evidence explicitly states that every dashboard action has an API equivalent, so UI parity is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity guarantee or a parity matrix, and independent hands-on confirmation that no dashboard-only actions exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: provides access to the entire Cloudflare API — over 2,500 endpoints across DNS, Workers, R2, Zero Trust, and every other product — through just two tools: search() and execute()
You can roll back to a previously deployed version of your Worker using Wrangler or the Cloudflare dashboard.
Wrangler offers a number of commands to manage your Cloudflare Workers.
